question.text: A particle is projected towards the north with speed <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mfrac bevelled="true"><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mfrac></math> at an angle <math><msup><mrow><mn>45</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msup></math> with horizontal. Ball gets horizontal acceleration of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mfrac bevelled="true"><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac></math> towards east due to wind. Range of ball (in meter) minus <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>42</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> will be

solution.text:
Time of flight : T=2usin⁡θg=22 s
Range (along north) =u2sin⁡2θg=40 m
Range (along east) =12aT2=30 m
∴ Range =302+402=50 m
